risk_explanation: The project is using an outdated version of Pydantic (1.10.13) which conflicts with the requirement in pyproject.toml (>=2). Upgrading to Pydantic 2.x is necessary to resolve this mismatch and benefit from performance improvements, but it requires code changes due to breaking API changes in validators and configuration.
steps: Update pydantic version in requirements.txt to align with pyproject.toml
Refactor linkwatch/config.py to use Pydantic V2 field_validator and ConfigDict
suggested_tests: Run existing tests to ensure validation logic (empty names, invalid URLs) still works with the new Pydantic API.
Verify that whitespace stripping on string fields is still active.
